![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14212614/assets/a7fb89105bc5a11837ed0f416b2327d88202e8e782fa4c114ac47b3d5d15421c.png)

The scatter plot for the data sets $x$ and $y$ of paired observations and the corresponding linear regression line are shown above.

According to the regression model, what is the residual for the highlighted datapoint?
question.worked_solution:
The residual equals the difference between the actual value of the dependent variable and the value estimated using the linear regression model:

$$
\text{Residual}=\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated}
$$

 

The highlighted datapoint has coordinates $(7,-2).$ So, our actual value is $y=-2.$

On the other hand, the point on the regression line that corresponds to $x=7$ has the $y$-coordinate $-4.$ So, our estimated value of is $\overset{^}{y}=-4.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14212614/assets/92a26b8ab019879dec3208878f6a0604c0616776b09e3f8fa916fcab72df3a73.png)

Therefore, the residual is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Residual} & =\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated} \\  & =y-\overset{^}{y} \\  & =-2-(-4) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
